Positive mean a/omega gives a unique positive periodic Green-kernel solution despite |epsilon|>=a; differences decay as e^(-Au-B(sinu-sinu0)), so all nonzero solutions converge, with physical time forward complete. Period from integrating dlog r/dtheta is 2pi a/(lambda omega), and one physical turn has Floquet multiplier exp(-4pi a/omega). Polar area = 1/2 int V du = pi lambda/omega int_0^infty exp(-At) I0(2B sin(t/2))dt. Tonelli yields positive entire B² power series and monotonicity. One interior saddle t=pi and I0 asymptotic give area ~[pi lambda/(2 |epsilon| sinh(pi a/omega))] exp(2|epsilon|/omega). Both angular period vs physical-turn factors were checked; finite checker source inspected, not treated as proof.
